title: ‘I love it here’: Pickleball star Anna Leigh Waters meets Pinoy fans in Manila
summary: World No. 1 pickleball player Anna Leigh Waters received a warm welcome from local fans as she met supporters at Bonifacio High Street Mall on her first day in Manila.
